sources.entry: Fazm - The fastest AI computer agent for macOS. Takes voice commands and controls your entire desktop.

summary.one_liner: Fazm is an open-source, local-first AI computer agent for macOS that takes voice commands and controls the desktop, browser, documents, and Google Apps.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Fazm as an AI agent that controls the user's browser, writes code, handles documents, operates Google Apps, and learns the user's workflow, all driven by voice. It is presented as free to start, fully open source, and fully local. The demos mention cross-platform people discovery, CRM data entry and updates, and tasks that use image and visual context. The repo is organized as a Swift/SwiftUI macOS app (SPM package) in Desktop/, a TypeScript ACP bridge for Claude integration in acp-bridge/, and DMG installer assets in dmg-assets/. The README says that billable model keys are fetched at runtime from a hosted backend, gated by auth.
use_cases: handling documents and Google Apps with an AI agent
how_to_run: Requires macOS 14.0+, Xcode, and code signing with an Apple Developer ID
./run.sh (builds the Swift app and launches it)
./reset-and-run.sh (run with a clean slate: resets onboarding, permissions, UserDefaults)
Optional: place a .env.app or .env.app.dev at the repo root to use your own backend instead of the hosted config
notable: Voice commands control the whole macOS desktop
Fully open source under MIT, with a local-first design per the README
Uses a hosted backend by default; the build fetches a non-secret bootstrap config and billable model keys are fetched at runtime behind auth
Can run against your own backend via .env.app files
caveats: Building requires code signing with an Apple Developer ID
Default setup depends on the hosted Fazm backend for sign-in and bundled AI
keywords: ai that writes code on mac
